description: Jet Set Radio Future: area unlock randomizer.

v1.0a.description:
This is the first alpha of the Jet Set Radio Future world for Archipelago.

It's for early testing: making sure seeds generate, the client connects to JSRF Unleashed, and both goals (Defeat Gouji and Jet Ranks) can be played start to finish. Expect rough edges, and things may change before the beta.

**Requirements:** Archipelago 0.6.8 or newer, and JSRF Unleashed 0.6.10 on Windows with your own copy of the game.

**To install:** download `jsrf.apworld` below and put it in your Archipelago `custom_worlds` folder. The setup guide is in `jsrf/docs/setup_en.md`.

**Found a problem?** Open an issue and attach the newest `JSRFClient_*.txt` from Archipelago's `logs` folder and `last-run.log` from your JSRF Unleashed folder.
v1.0a.title: v1.0a

v1.1a.description:
## Bug fixes

- **Game over or losing a rival fight no longer breaks your game.** If you went back to the main menu and started a New Game, Corn's talk didn't send you to the free-skate Garage, so you were stuck in the Garage. Now a New Game works the same every time.
- **Progress you lost is put back.** If a game over or an old save loses progress the server already has, the client puts it back when you reach the free-skate Garage. That covers Graffiti Souls, Street Challenges, Mystery Tapes, rival gang wins, Jet ranks and graffiti tags.
- **Restored tags stay sprayed.** Some areas cleared certain tags the first time you entered them after a New Game, even after the client had put them back. They now stay sprayed.
- **The pause screen's Graffiti Soul total is correct.** It now shows the Graffiti Soul items you've received from Archipelago, not the souls you've picked up in the game.
- **Item notices stay with the game window.** Another window placed over the game now covers them, and they hide while the game is minimized.

To update, replace `jsrf.apworld` in your `custom_worlds` folder. Seeds made with the earlier v1.0a still work.
v1.1a.title: v1.1a

v1.2a.description:
## Bug fixes

- **Another game's collect or release no longer counts as your progress.** When another world in your multiworld reached its goal with collect on, or someone used `!collect` or `!release`, the client treated JSRF's newly marked checks as progress you'd lost. It wrote them into your save as cleared Street Challenges, picked-up Graffiti Souls, Jet ranks and sprayed tags. That could open Gouji's Tower, or complete the Jet Ranks goal, before you'd done the work yourself.
- **Only your own progress is put back after a game over.** The client now keeps a record on the Archipelago server of what you've actually done in your game. After a game over or a New Game it puts back only what's in that record.
- **Collected checks you do yourself still count.** If another world collected a Street Challenge or tag spot and you clear or spray it later anyway, it counts toward Gouji's Tower as usual.
- **Collected Graffiti Souls stay in the level.** Picking one up doesn't send anything new, because the server already has that check. This matches how other Archipelago games handle collected locations.

To update, replace `jsrf.apworld` in your `custom_worlds` folder. Seeds made with the earlier v1.0a still work. For a seed you started before this update, the client begins its record with whatever your save shows done the first time the new client connects.
v1.2a.title: v1.2a

v1.3a.description:
## Bug fixes

- **Mystery Tapes can no longer trap you in the pickup animation.** Occasionally, picking up a Mystery Tape replayed the pickup animation over and over, and the tape could never be collected. This happened when the client wasn't watching the game at that moment, for example while its connection to the server dropped, right after it connected, or after it was closed or crashed.
- **The game now handles the tape pickup itself.** Picking up a tape records the pickup in your save and removes the tape the same way the original game does. You get one pickup animation and the tape disappears, whether or not the client is watching.
- **Tapes picked up while the client is away still count.** If you pick up a tape while the client is disconnected, it sends the check as soon as it reconnects.
- **Street Challenges still follow the Mystery Tape items.** Picking up a tape doesn't open the area's Street Challenges. Receiving that area's Mystery Tape item does.

## Changes

- **The Future Site of Rokkaku Expo Stadium has its own name.** Jazz's recruit check is now "The Future Site of Rokkaku Expo Stadium - Jazz Joins".
- **New check: the stadium's save point graffiti.** When graffiti tags are on, "The Future Site of Rokkaku Expo Stadium - Save Point Tag" is a check, which brings the total to 573 tag spots. If Gouji's Tower needs a share of tag spots, it now counts from 573 (50% is 287).
- **Both stadium checks need the 99th Street Unlock.** The stadium still has no Unlock of its own. If you spray its graffiti or race Jazz before you have the 99th Street Unlock, the client holds the check until it arrives.

To update, replace `jsrf.apworld` in your `custom_worlds` folder and restart the client. Seeds made with the earlier v1.0a still work and get the Mystery Tape fix, but the stadium's new name and its tag check only appear in newly generated seeds. If you're already in an area when you update, leave it once so the area loads its tape with the fix.
